interface.longDescription: Search Wiro models and pricing, generate images, videos, audio and text, track and resume tasks, review billed costs and troubleshoot connections. Independent integration using the official Wiro MCP server; not affiliated with Wiro. Requires a secure connected Wiro project.
defaultPrompt: Find the best Wiro model for my task and compare its pricing.
Help me generate an image or video with Wiro.
Show my recent Wiro tasks and their results.

name: wiro-ai-plugin
description: Discover, compare, execute and monitor Wiro AI models with safe authentication, pricing checks, reusable workflows and task management.
